title: Record one signed four-entry n=8 parity prefix at 3/2 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

For the `n = 8` symbol `(1, 1/8, 1/8, 1/8, -1/8, 0, 0, 0)`, every proper prefix has infinity norm at most `3/2`. The largest is `3/2`. The right shear alone is `633/512`, and the next four proper prefixes are `11/8`. This is the signed four-entry step left open by #4782. The branch is from fetched main `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43` and does not replay that open package.

The tail `l1` is `1/2`. The schedule applies the right shear, then the even child, then the Schur child, then the left shear, and repeats that order inside every child. There are 22 factors and 21 proper prefixes. The quotient is `(1/8, 7/64, 1/512, 55/4096)`. The first prefix's bottom row sums to `1 + 1/8 + 7/64 + 1/512 = 633/512`. The even child's right shear, with entry `1/8`, lifts the next four proper prefixes to `11/8`. The even grandchild's left shear has entry `-1/8` and lifts the running product to `3/2`, and the remaining 16 proper prefixes stay there. The product of the 22 factors equals the even/odd reordering of the Toeplitz matrix.

`633/512 < 11/8 < 3/2 < 9/4`. The sign changes the even child from `(1, 1/8, 1/8, 0)` to `(1, 1/8, -1/8, 0)` and lowers only the opening shear, from the positive four-entry value `647/512` to `633/512`. The later proper-prefix values match that path. The Schur child is `(1, 7/64, -79/512, -57/4096)`. Nine nontrivial factors sit in the proper prefixes.

This is one symbol. It does not bound every tail of `l1` at most `1/2`, the generator-shear compiler, the completed Gaussian stage, or the dyadic `p^100` normalizer. No new κ. The selected record is `60403/20000000`.

## Test plan

- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/triangular-parity-signed-four-entry`
- [x] Prints `PASS_TRIANGULAR_PARITY_SIGNED_FOUR_ENTRY` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`, priority revision 7. Upstream fetches at 2026-10-22T19:58:09Z and the pre-submit fetch at 2026-10-22T20:01:45Z were that commit. The pinned blobs of `certificates/selected-result.json` (`c35482cd9035843b15a634cc8276a7e1e40e8395`), `GAUSSIAN.md` (`adfb28c93e6b06178c901caaac39ede41a9e541b`), and `vendor/SHALLOW-TOEPLITZ.md` (`bc4349b2daea548ffa09e1f38a31f1df86b0b7be`) were unchanged. κ remains `60403/20000000`.

Prepared by James Reed with substantial Cursor Grok 4.7 assistance.
